entities.summary: Emanuel Gottlieb Leutze was a German-born American history painter, best known for his 1851 painting Washington Crossing the Delaware. He is associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting. Emanuel Leutze was a authors & novelists from Schwäbisch Gmünd (1816-05-24, Schwäbisch Gmünd–1868-07-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
